name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: plugins with function hooks for panes, bands, toasts, routing and subagent tooling.

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: Pixel-art studio view of your subagents with status cards, a cross-session office building, and a local router that picks each subagent's model and effort. Sends nothing out.

plugins.name: clawd
plugins.description: A pixel mascot in the band above the prompt that reacts to what the session is doing. Sends nothing out.

plugins.name: context-keeper
plugins.description: Toasts at 60% and 75% of the compaction point that ask you to run /compact at the end of a task. /keeper shows the context fill.

plugins.name: conversation-atlas-plus
plugins.description: A live map of your session and your other sessions: goal, current activity, tasks, open questions and working files. Rebuilt from Conversation Atlas (MIT, by Neel).

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Consistent subagent deployment: a delegation policy, a check on each Agent call, concurrency caps, warn-only token budgets, five role agents and /delegate score.

plugins.name: gauntlet
plugins.description: /gauntlet: fresh sub-agents compete on one hard task, attack and defend each other's answers, and a blind judge picks the winner. Built from arena-skill (MIT, Jake Schincariol).

plugins.name: mod-dock
plugins.description: A dock above the prompt that lists your mods, marks the loaded ones and opens each mod's window.

plugins.name: session-pulse
plugins.description: A board (/pulse) of every session on this machine: which need you, which are working, which are done. Sends nothing out.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Token, cost, context and rate-limit meter: a status entry, a band, a pane and threshold toasts. Sends nothing out.
